listing.name: Strikecraft Standalone v1.0.0
listing.summary: Do you want to use mods that include strikecraft, but don't want to have the full suite of armaa's features, such as its faction and mechs, in your game?

description:
Do you want to use mods that include strikecraft, but don't want to have the full suite of armaa's features, such as its faction and mechs, in your game?

Then this mod is for you! It includes the Strikecraft hullmod and absolutely nothing else from armaa, effectively satiating mods that normally have armaa as a dependency due to including strikecraft. This mod *does* use the original ID of the strikecraft hullmod as well so, presuming the mod in question doesn't rely on any other aspect of armaa, this mod should work as a substitute that you can just drop in and should work out the box.

Important: Do *NOT* run this mod alongside armaa, use one or the other. Besides there being no reason to do so as armaa contains everything in this mod to start with, the two will also crash the game if used alongside eachother.

I do strongly recommend still using armaa instead of this as it is an awesome mod, but to each their own.

All credit to Shoi for the original armaa.
